prompt: Some people think that the increasing use of technology in the workplace is beneficial for employees, while others believe that it has a negative impact on workers. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay: While many individuals believe that youngsters should spend more time doing homework, others think that they should take more free time playing and enjoying activities outside school. From my perspective, i believe that children should gain experiences trying new subjects and taking up more hobbies because that may help them to unwind after school. One major reason why communities believe that children should spend more time doing assignments and homework is that it leads to excellent grades at school. This is mainly because if youngsters put an effort in their studies and spend a lot of time doing homework, they will be capable of mastering the curriculum and subject and they may not find it so hard to follow. For instance, if a group of children decide that they should have the proclivity to do their homework and accomplish assignments, they may graduate from primary school with the highest scores because of their consistency in finishing homework. Consequently, children who are capable of managing their daily homework may have better chances when it comes to graduating with the best grades. On the other hand, a significant number of people argue that children should spend more free time playing and participating in outdoor activities. This is chiefly because if youngsters have the opportunity to engage in recreational activities, they will be capable of relieving the pressure and stress of school life. For example, if kids spend hours playing sports or exploring new hobbies with friends, they may develop essential social skills and stay physically active. Consequently, children who balance their studying with enough playing time may have better mental health and a more enjoyable childhood. In conclusion, while some individuals believe that focusing heavily on homework and academic assignments is essential for getting the best grades, others think that children need more free time for playing outside. From my perspective, i believe that allowing children to explore new hobbies and unwind through outdoor activities is crucial for their overall development alongside their studies.
